description: This file defines a Flutter widget `FeaturedTiles` that renders a horizontal, scrollable row of featured items, each represented by a `FeaturedItem`. It manages layout calculations for different screen sizes and maintains visual consistency with the app's theme. It also includes a private widget `_FeaturedTile` for individual tile rendering.

classes.name: FeaturedTiles
classes.description: A widget that displays a horizontally scrollable row of featured action tiles, designed for responsiveness and visual consistency.

classes.name: _FeaturedTile
classes.description: A private widget representing an individual feature tile, including icon, label, and interaction behavior.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the `FeaturedTiles` widget, calculating tile widths based on layout constraints and building a horizontal list of feature tiles.

methods.name: _FeaturedTile build
methods.description: Builds the individual tile with semantics, styling, icon, and label.
